heading: Follow the work, not a black box.
intro: Inspectable inputs, context references, tool decisions and reviewable outputs.
privacyNotice: This inspector shows operational records and concise decision explanations. Private model reasoning and hidden chain-of-thought are not requested or displayed.

replayRecent.title: Replay recent runs
replayRecent.intro: Runs the latest 10 finished runs again with their recorded inputs, in a read-only sandbox, to see whether today's rules still reach the same plans. No provider is called and no learner record changes.
replayRecent.none: No finished run with a recorded plan to replay yet.
replayRecent.summary: {matches} reached the same plan, {diverged} differed, {notReplayable} could not be replayed. Each replay is listed in the audit log.
